sources.title: Flipkart Builds Proprietary E-Commerce LLMs as AI Generates Up to 40% ...
sources.snippet: The company is integrating AI across customer experiences, seller services, engineering processes, and operational workflows, positioning itself at the forefront of AI-driven retail innovation. Speaking to Moneycontrol, Thiagarajan revealed that approximately 35-40% of Flipkart's software code is already being generated by AI-powered tools.

sources.title: GitHub - QuantumWebber/Flipkart-ai
sources.snippet: Flipkart AI — E-Commerce Product Intelligence Platform A FastAPI backend + React frontend that takes a live Flipkart product URL and runs it through five independent analysis modules — computer vision, NLP, price forecasting, and recommendations — to help a shopper decide whether a listing is trustworthy and well-priced.

sources.title: Ashik-kumar3/AI-Product-Description-Generator - GitHub
sources.snippet: A GPT-2 based AI application that generates product descriptions through fine-tuning on the Flipkart Product Dataset, featuring model evaluation and an interactive Streamlit interface.

sources.title: Flipkart Accelerates AI Strategy with 250+ Models and Custom LLMs
sources.snippet: Flipkart has deployed more than 250 AI models across its ecosystem as it accelerates artificial intelligence adoption in customer experience, seller services and engineering, according to Balaji Thiagarajan Chief Product and Technology Officer.
